groups.schedules-jobs.title: Cards of limits on the General settings page. Socios are AI agents; a Space is a product noun (a shared area for a team).
groups.schedules-jobs.intro: Intro under the "Schedules and jobs" limits card heading on the General settings page: socios (AI agents) running on a schedule or as background jobs without a person asking.
groups.data-space.title: Heading of a limits card: how much each person may store in datasets (tables of data) and files.
groups.data-space.intro: Intro under the "Data space" limits card heading on the General settings page: datasets are tables of data a person keeps; lowering a limit blocks new data but deletes nothing.
groups.shared-areas.title: Heading of a limits card: what a company socio (an AI agent the whole company shares) keeps for everyone who uses it.
groups.shared-areas.intro: Intro under the "Socios’ shared areas" limits card heading on the General settings page: a company socio is an AI agent the whole company shares. "Data → Shared with socios" names a page and its section: keep it matching the app.
groups.plugin-datasets.title: Heading of a limits card: datasets (tables of data) that plugins own and fill.
groups.plugin-datasets.intro: Intro under the "Plugin datasets" limits card heading on the General settings page: tables of data a plugin owns and fills. "Data page" names a page in the app.
groups.analytical-tables.title: Heading of a limits card: compressed history tables plugins keep for reports and analysis.
groups.analytical-tables.intro: Intro under the "Analytical tables" limits card heading on the General settings page: compressed history tables for reports. DuckDB is a product name; "partitions" are slices of a table by date.
groups.dot-turns.title: Heading of a limits card: how much work a socio (AI agent) may do for one reply.
groups.dot-turns.intro: Intro under the "Socio replies" limits card heading on the General settings page: a socio is an AI agent; a reply is all the work it does for one message.
groups.memory.title: Heading of a limits card: how long socios (AI agents) keep what they remember of people’s chats, and each Space’s shared memory.
groups.memory.intro: Intro under the "Memory" limits card heading on the General settings page: what socios (AI agents) remember across a person’s chats. Space is a product noun (a shared area for a team).
groups.rooms.title: Heading of a limits card: the most one message, and the work it starts, may use in any chat.
groups.rooms.intro: Intro under the "Work per message" limits card heading on the General settings page: "turn time limit" and "queued-message limit" refer to fields on the "Socio replies" card above. Telegram is a product name; a topic is a thread in a Telegram group.
groups.continuous-copy.title: Heading of a limits card: when admins are alerted that the continuous copy (Litestream’s copy of the database) is falling behind.
groups.continuous-copy.intro: Intro under the "Continuous copy alerts" limits card heading on the General settings page: Litestream is a product name; the write-ahead log is the database’s file of recent changes.
groups.plugin-backups.title: Heading of a limits card: how much of each plugin’s own storage is backed up.
groups.plugin-backups.intro: Intro under the "Plugin backups" limits card heading on the General settings page: a snapshot is one backup of a plugin’s own storage.
limits.scheduleMinIntervalMinutes.label: Each limit: label (the field's label), unit (shown after the number field, plural, such as "minutes" or "MB") and help (the line under it). MB, GiB and USD are unit symbols.
limits.scheduleMinIntervalMinutes.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Shortest gap between runs", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.scheduleMinIntervalMinutes.help: Help line under the "Shortest gap between runs" field on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card; "The server starts at …" (startsAt) follows it. A schedule is a recurring task; socios are AI agents
limits.schedulesPerUser.label: Field label on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card, followed by a number field: how many active schedules (recurring tasks) one person’s socios (AI agents) may have.
limits.schedulesPerUser.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Active schedules per person", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.
limits.schedulesPerUser.help: Help line under the "Active schedules per person" field on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card; "The server starts at …" (startsAt) follows it. Socios are AI agents

limits.jobMaxTimeoutSeconds.help: Help line under the "Longest job timeout" field on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card; "The server starts at …" (startsAt) follows it. A job is background work; "a job that runs until done" works through its items in batches, and "its computer" is the machine it runs on

limits.jobConcurrency.help: Help line under the "Jobs running at once" field on the "Schedules and jobs" limits card; "The server starts at …" (startsAt) follows it. Jobs beyond the limit wait in line

limits.jobBatchRetries.unit: Unit shown after the number field of "Retries in a row", and as {{units}} in the invalid error. Plural.

saved: Toast: {{title}} is the card's title from groups.
reset: Toast: {{title}} is the card's title from groups.
invalid: Error: {{label}} is the field's label, {{min}} and {{max}} its range, {{units}} its unit.
startsAt: Follows a limit's help: the value the server uses when nobody changed it here.
useDefaults: Button on each limits card: puts every limit on that card back to the value the server starts with.
